I’ll now map drug exposures through RxNorm ingredient ancestry, so brand/formulation records roll up to pathway classes.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH ra AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_ra
    ON ca_ra.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
   AND ca_ra.ancestor_concept_id = 80809
), class_terms AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('TNF pathway inhibitors','adalimumab'),('TNF pathway inhibitors','etanercept'),('TNF pathway inhibitors','infliximab'),('TNF pathway inhibitors','certolizumab pegol'),('TNF pathway inhibitors','golimumab'),
    ('IL-6 pathway inhibitors','tocilizumab'),('IL-6 pathway inhibitors','sarilumab'),
    ('JAK-STAT pathway inhibitors','tofacitinib'),('JAK-STAT pathway inhibitors','baricitinib'),('JAK-STAT pathway inhibitors','upadacitinib'),
    ('T-cell costimulation modulators','abatacept'),
    ('B-cell/CD20 depletion','rituximab'),
    ('IL-1 pathway inhibitors','anakinra'),
    ('Antimetabolite / folate pathway DMARD','methotrexate'),
    ('Pyrimidine synthesis inhibitor DMARD','leflunomide'),
    ('Antimalarial / TLR-lysosome immunomodulator','hydroxychloroquine'),
    ('Sulfasalazine / NF-kB-inflammatory mediator DMARD','sulfasalazine')
  ) AS v(class_name, ingredient_name)
), ingredients AS (
  SELECT ct.class_name, c.concept_id AS ingredient_concept_id, c.concept_name AS ingredient_concept_name
  FROM class_terms ct
  JOIN omop.concept c
    ON c.domain_id='Drug'
   AND c.concept_class_id='Ingredient'
   AND c.standard_concept='S'
   AND LOWER(c.concept_name) = ct.ingredient_name
), drug_rollup AS (
  SELECT i.class_name, i.ingredient_concept_name, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM ingredients i
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
    ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = i.ingredient_concept_id
), hits AS (
  SELECT dr.class_name, dr.ingredient_concept_name, de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_id
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN ra ON ra.person_id = de.person_id
  JOIN drug_rollup dr ON dr.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
)
SELECT class_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS ra_patients_exposed,
       COUNT(*) AS exposure_records,
       STRING_AGG(CAST(ingredient_concept_name AS varchar(max)), '; ') AS matched_ingredients
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT class_name, ingredient_concept_name, person_id, drug_exposure_id FROM hits) x
GROUP BY class_name
ORDER BY ra_patients_exposed DESC, exposure_records DESC;

arguments.sql_query:
WITH ra AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_ra
    ON ca_ra.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
   AND ca_ra.ancestor_concept_id = 80809
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS ra_patients FROM ra;

WITH ra AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_ra
    ON ca_ra.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
   AND ca_ra.ancestor_concept_id = 80809
), class_terms AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('TNF pathway inhibitors','adalimumab'),('TNF pathway inhibitors','etanercept'),('TNF pathway inhibitors','infliximab'),('TNF pathway inhibitors','certolizumab pegol'),('TNF pathway inhibitors','golimumab'),
    ('IL-6 pathway inhibitors','tocilizumab'),('IL-6 pathway inhibitors','sarilumab'),
    ('JAK-STAT pathway inhibitors','tofacitinib'),('JAK-STAT pathway inhibitors','baricitinib'),('JAK-STAT pathway inhibitors','upadacitinib'),
    ('T-cell costimulation modulators','abatacept'),
    ('B-cell/CD20 depletion','rituximab'),
    ('IL-1 pathway inhibitors','anakinra'),
    ('Antimetabolite / folate-pathway DMARD','methotrexate'),
    ('Pyrimidine synthesis inhibitor DMARD','leflunomide'),
    ('Antimalarial / TLR-lysosome immunomodulator','hydroxychloroquine'),
    ('Sulfasalazine / inflammatory-mediator DMARD','sulfasalazine')
  ) AS v(class_name, ingredient_name)
), ingredients AS (
  SELECT ct.class_name, c.concept_id AS ingredient_concept_id
  FROM class_terms ct
  JOIN omop.concept c
    ON c.domain_id='Drug'
   AND c.concept_class_id='Ingredient'
   AND c.standard_concept='S'
   AND LOWER(c.concept_name) = ct.ingredient_name
), drug_rollup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.class_name, ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM ingredients i
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
    ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = i.ingredient_concept_id
), hits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dr.class_name, de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_id
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN ra ON ra.person_id = de.person_id
  JOIN drug_rollup dr ON dr.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
)
SELECT class_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS ra_patients_exposed,
       COUNT(DISTINCT drug_exposure_id) AS exposure_records
FROM hits
GROUP BY class_name
ORDER BY ra_patients_exposed DESC, exposure_records DESC;
